report.body:
Spain's National Police arrested four men and one woman in Palma, Mallorca, on
suspicion of belonging to a group dedicated to drug trafficking. Police
said a months-long investigation began after agents learned of a parcel
containing 24 kg of hashish addressed to a man living in Palma. Officers
identified the recipient, seized the parcel and detained him on suspicion of
drug trafficking before finding that other suspects and two homes could hold
more substances.

In the main suspect's home, officers found 36 kg of hashish, a compressed-air
rifle with a silencer and about 10,000 euros in cash, and detained the man and a
woman on suspicion of drug trafficking and membership of a criminal
organisation. In a second home, officers detained a man suspected of
storing and transporting drugs and seized 2 kg of cocaine, doses of the drug,
cutting substance, a 9 mm pistol with cartridges, a bow with arrows and a
hydraulic press.

Police detained another person linked to the case and said the investigation
remained open, with agents suspecting the drugs were distributed to others for
smaller-scale sale.
